Payload.$Comment: Keeps every mob Mob Scaling scales in the restless graveyard (the Seasons of Orbis dungeon Seasons_Of_Orbis_Restless_Graveyard, the full moon's endless run) between level 1 and level 10, the Horseman's normal graveyard's band. Each copy of a CommonLib dungeon is a world named after the dungeon's file, a dash and the copy's number (seasons_of_orbis_restless_graveyard-1, seasons_of_orbis_restless_graveyard-2 and so on), so this prefix pattern reaches every copy. Floor is the level a mob starts at: a dungeon copy is a void world with no zone or biome, so this world floor is the one that applies there, in place of the global Floor. A nearby group's power raises the level from there, and MinCap and MaxCap clamp the result whatever the zone mappings, distance escalation or group power come to, so 10 is as high as it goes and 1 as low. The run grows its waves itself, wave by wave (the dungeon's Run.Endless.Ramp), on top of whatever this band gives each creature, so the band stays low and the reach of a run is its difficulty. The Voidtaken Horseman rises from a spawn marker his run fires by hand, which Mob Scaling never rolls, so only the run's ramp grows him. DistanceEscalation is off so an area's distance from the copy's spawn point adds nothing, and PlayerScalingStartRingBlocks is 0 so a group's power counts from the first block: the protected ring around spawn would otherwise cover the whole copy and leave group scaling off. To move the band, set Floor and MinCap to the new bottom and MaxCap to the new top; add "Enabled": false to switch scaling off in the restless graveyard entirely.
